'''Althyn Conly''' is a [[novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] camp. She is from the [[Two Rivers]].

== Activities ==
She and [[Bodewhin Cauthon]] try to change two cups at once into ''[[cuendillar]]'' but only end up with a solid lump.

She is one of only 24 novices, 2 Accepted and 9 Aes Sedai in the Rebel camp who could make ''cuendillar''.
